text:
maria: Heads up—nightly CI flagged a flaky: RuntimeRetryTest::payload_ordering. Failed 2/3 on linux-x86 nightlies. Logs attached.

akshay: seen it, thanks. can you paste the failing assertion and the job link?

maria: assertion: `expected [A,B,C] got [A,C,B]` in RetryQueueTest::ProcessAfterPrefetch. Job: https://ci.example.com/builds/1972 (artifact: /artifacts/1972/log.txt)

ci-bot: Build 1972 — FAILURE
ci-bot: failing test: RuntimeRetryTest::payload_ordering (test binary: runtime_test)

olivia: quick theory — this smells like a race in prefetch+retry where timers reorder callbacks under load. did the run have concurrent prefetch enabled? env: PREFETCH=on, BATCHER_THREADS=8

maria: yes, nightly config. local reproducer: `./runtime_test --gtest_filter=RuntimeRetryTest.payload_ordering --run_under=tools/slowstart  --repeat=100` fails ~1/30

akshay: can you try with `--shuffle-seed=42` and `RUNTIME_DEBUG_ORDERING=1` to get deterministic trace? also add `--print-callback-stack` if available.

maria: running now with seed 42. if it repros I'll upload trace. ETA ~2m.

james: pinging in case akshay or olivia want to grab the bisect. if it's seed-dependent we can spawn a bisect matrix across nightly runners.

olivia: if it's timing-related, try increasing `RETRY_BACKOFF_BASE_MS` to 10ms to see if it stabilizes. if that reduces repro rate, it's timing window.

maria: update: repro'd on seed 42. trace shows two retry callbacks scheduled at t and t+1 but processed in reverse order on worker thread 3. stack:
```
#0 RetryQueue::process
#1 Worker::run
#2 thread_start
```

akshay: ok that suggests queue ordering rely on non-atomic counter when two callbacks have equal deadline. quick patch: make sequence counter 64-bit atomic and add test. i'll open a tiny PR and run CI.

olivia: if you PR, include a unit that creates 1e4 collisions on deadline to catch future regressions.

maria: thanks. akshay can you also trigger a rerun matrix for the failing nightly with `BATCHER_THREADS=4,8,12` to see sensitivity?

akshay: will do. starting PR now -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4826

ci-bot: PR 4826 — checks queued

maria: great. tagging @olivia to review the test shape. i'll keep monitoring nightly and will post back if anything else crops up :thumbsup:

akshay: quick note — if anyone sees other ordering flakiness, add `--shuffle-seed` to reproducer runs, it saved me a ton when bisecting this one.

james: thanks all. assigning follow-ups: akshay (patch + reruns), olivia (test review), maria (nightly monitor).
